view_issues: Footnote ¶¶¶ gives a ρ for the Adirondacks 'on June 7', but a correlation cannot be computed on one day; it is probably June 1–14. The Conclusions call 179.1% and 132.8% increases 'twofold'. 'rho' usually denotes Spearman, yet the text says Pearson.
